'''Price''' was a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] living during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He suspected that [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] were infecting the captive [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] with a [[Disease/Legends|disease]] that lowered their life expectancy.
